title: Price Comparison
description: Azalai from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by one of his orders.

mainQuestExcel.title: Price Comparison
mainQuestExcel.description: Azalai from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by one of his orders.

dialogs.text: I'll have to ask Raef to find someone...
Why the long face?
What are you looking to buy, Traveler? I'm afraid that we may be somewhat out of stock.
So that's what troubles you?
Yes... This is a desert village, so shipment has always been troublesome for us.
Whenever I want to source some wares, I need to ask those who happen to leave the village to place an order for me, then transport it to the village together with Raef.
One way or another, my business costs are slowly rising. To make ends meet, I have no other choice than to increase my prices.
Thankfully, the people of this village understand my predicament and are willing to support my business, otherwise... I would've gone bankrupt a long time ago.
But, alas... I can't find anyone who's planning to leave the village, and Raef and his crew aren't always available...
If I'm unlucky, some low-volume goods may be out of stock soon...
And those goods are...
They are all daily essentials. Even though I'm usually quick to source them, they sell even quicker.
I'm running a small business, so I can't always buy large volumes.
Ahem... that's a topic for another day. Traveler, perhaps you are getting ready to leave the village?
I've been wanting to source some spices and need someone to place an order for me... Could you assist me with this?
Leave it to me.
Let me see... <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama's</color> spices are fairly priced and the quality is... serviceable.

<color=#00E1FFFF>Jut</color> has recently got his hands on some novelty spices — the quality's quite promising. I'd like to give them a shot, just to see if there's any demand, but I'm not sure about the price point...
But my budget for this purchase is limited, so deciding which supplier to choose isn't going to be easy...
Traveler, please check out both suppliers and pick one to place an order with.
Oh, one more thing. Whenever I commissioned someone to place an order for me in the past, I'd ask them to look for a relatively cheap price point.
I'd like you to do the same. Please remember to look for the cheaper supplier.
The business strategy that's been working in Aaru Village so far is "selling more at a lower profit margin."
I'll check out what <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama</color> has to offer first...
Thank you in advance. I'll mark her location on the map for you.
Alright, come back anytime if you have any additional questions.
I'll check out what <color=#00E1FFFF>Jut</color> has to offer first...
Thank you in advance. I'll mark his location on the map for you.
So spices are out of stock in your store?
I wouldn't say we've run out completely... but given how big the sales volumes are, it's always better to have some more in stock.
If only you could find a long-term business partner...
It's not like I haven't considered that, but look around you.
Shipping goods into the village and running business here aren't exactly easy.

flow.stepDescription: Learn about the situation from Rama

dialogs.text: How did it go? Have you placed an order yet?
About <color=#00E1FFFF>Rama's</color> location...
You can't find her exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.
You should be good to go now. I'm counting on you, Traveler.
About <color=#00E1FFFF>Jut's</color> location...
You can't find his exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.
Welcome! Want to buy some spices? We have all the usuals, and all at affordable prices!
About Azalai's order...
Huh? Azalai asked you to place an order for him? No problem at all...
It's just that he used to ask the Eremites to source his goods, and this time, he commissioned an Adventurer...
Ahem! What's his budget today? Let's see... Ooh, quite a bit.
Uh, if you place an order at my store, the spices supplied by me should last him for a long while.
As for the selling price... Just like before, I suggest setting a slightly lower price point. That's an easy way to boost sales.
I'd like to place my order here.
Oh! Thanks for your patronage! Please wait a moment while I make preparations and arrange delivery.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
Okay... Come back and tell me if you change your mind.
Made up your mind yet? Want to place your order with me?
I'd like to place my order here.
Thanks for your patronage! Please wait a moment while I make preparations and arrange delivery.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
Alright. But hurry up, please. If you wait too long, I may be out of stock.
Hi, are you shopping for spices?
About Azalai's order...
For this amount... He won't be able to buy much. However, my spices are worth a lot of Mora.
Well... Since it's his order, I'll add my two cents. As a friend, I don't really recommend him to buy from me.
From what I gathered about business in Aaru Village... I'd say that "selling more at a lower price point" is the way to go.
Simply put, it's about selling goods of passable quality for a relatively low price, and selling large quantities fast as a way to make a quick return on the invested capital.
Conversely, if he tries to sell expensive high-quality goods in Aaru Village, the return will be slow.
But this is just my opinion. It's up to him what kind of goods he decides to sell.
I'd like to order from you.
Alright. I'll go prepare the goods then.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
All good. If you still want to order from me, feel free to come back anytime.
How's it going? Made up your mind yet?
I'd like to order from you.
Alright. I'll go prepare the goods then.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
I understand. We're talking about no small sums. Careful consideration is highly advised, indeed.

flow.stepDescription: Learn about the situation from Butrus

dialogs.text: How did it go? Have you placed an order yet?
About <color=#00E1FFFF>Butrus'</color> location...
You can't find his exact location? Okay... I'll mark that spot on the map for you.
You should be good to go now. I'm counting on you, Traveler.
About <color=#00E1FFFF>Jahangir's</color> location...
Welcome! Are you looking for fish? Then you've come to the right place! There are no fish fresher than mine. Ask that cat over there if you don't believe me.
About Azalai's order...
Huh... Azalai is looking to source some Dried Fish from me? No worries.
This amount of Mora is enough to buy a large quantity of Dried Fish. It should last him for a while.
Though my Dried Fish is... well... faithful to the original flavor! No spices or anything like that.
I'd like to place my order here.
Alright! Hehe... I'll go pick out some Dried Fish and get someone to deliver his order to him in a bit.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
Huh? Fine... Go ahead and compare prices.
But I can't really afford to give you another discount. I won't make any profit otherwise.
What say you? Want to order Dried Fish from me?
I'd like to place my order here.
Alright! Hehe... I'll go pick out some Dried Fish and get someone to deliver his order to him in a bit.
I'll try my luck elsewhere.
Don't be too long or there won't be any Dried Fish left.
Welcome! Would you like to have a bite? Everything's freshly made.
About Azalai's order...
Ahaha, sure! I told him my Dried Fish is famous far and wide and will definitely sell for a good price.
This amount of Mora will get you some Dried Fish. Just say the word and I'll make a fresh batch for you.
You'll start drying it now?
Of course not! What I meant was going to my warehouse to take the Dried Fish out and seasoning them to elevate their flavor profile.
Wait a minute... With the cost considered, you won't be able to buy that much Dried Fish after all.
I'd like to place my order here.
Okay! I'll send one of my employees to deliver the order when I'm done making Dried Fish.
I—I'm going to look elsewhere...
Huh? No need to rush, the price is negotiable. Besides, you won't find such tasty Dried Fish anywhere else!
Hey, have you decided yet? One word and I'll start prepping everything.
I'd like to place my order here.
Okay! I'll send one of my employees to deliver the order when I'm done making Dried Fish.
I—I'm going to look elsewhere...
Huh? Didn't I say you wouldn't find such tasty Dried Fish elsewhere? There's not much to think about...

Thanks for your help, Traveler. This is your remuneration. And this Mora, please take it along, too.
That miser Rama though... I've ordered so many times from her, and she never gave me a discount.

It's nothing I can't handle. Worst case scenario, I'll cut the Dried Fish up and sell it that way.
Ah... Um, here is your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help.
How many pieces can these be cut into?
